OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 with the Linux Bambu network-plugin bridge (PLB). On Windows the Bambu network plugin runs inside a bundled WSL2 runtime; on Linux it runs natively.

## Known issues
- **Windows:** with cloud-connected printers, the camera may show `Connection Failed [1:403]` and sending a print job may fail with a 403 error. Printer status and filament info still work. This build includes a possible fix that hasn't been confirmed yet. If you still see a 403, please open an issue with your printer model and whether it's connected through the cloud or LAN.
- **Fedora:** opening the camera can close the application.

## Downloads
| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows | `OrcaSlicer_Windows_Installer_V2.4.2_x64.exe` (installer) or `OrcaSlicer_Windows_V2.4.2_portable.zip` |
| Ubuntu / Debian | `.deb` for Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04, or the `LinuxDir` `.tar.gz` (unpack and run) |
| Any Linux | `OrcaSlicer-BMCU_Linux_AppImage_…AppImage` |
| Fedora 41–44 | `.rpm` for your Fedora version |
